source_counterexample.failure: INT finalizer archived a still-mutating wave.fsdb/chain/slist/xlist set and a transient wave.fsdb.slock while simulator/writer termination was unproven.

required_next_fresh.launch: On Linux, enable PR_SET_CHILD_SUBREAPER, run the actual simulator as a child in a fresh POSIX session/process group and record root PID/PGID.
required_next_fresh.signal_or_timeout: Apply an explicit internal runtime timeout as well as INT/HUP/TERM; enumerate descendants and subreaper-adopted escapees, TERM the owned group plus escaped descendants, wait, KILL only remaining owned processes, wait/reap root plus adopted children and prove every owned PID absent.
required_next_fresh.heartbeat: Emit periodic identity-bound rows with contiguous sequence, host monotonic time, exact observed simulation time and timescale. Host liveness is separate from simulation-time advance.
required_next_fresh.snapshot: Only after process-tree quiescence, hash wave.fsdb and every shard twice with a bounded settle interval; exact sets and bytes/SHA must match and no transient lock/temp/empty member may exist.
required_next_fresh.failure: Publish partial raw/core return and mark DIAGNOSTIC_EVIDENCE_INCOMPLETE; never claim a stable/complete waveform or simulator termination from return publication alone.

positive_controls: natural root exit with all writer descendants gone and stable two-snapshot exact set
INT/TERM/timeout TERM then bounded KILL and complete owned-process disappearance
simulation-time heartbeat advances independently of host liveness
negative_controls: orphan simulator or writer PID remains
descendant escapes expected PGID and is not individually terminated
double-forked writer is not adopted and reaped by the supervisor
wave.fsdb or shard changes between snapshots
host heartbeat continues while no same-attempt simulation-time advance is ever observed
simv exit or return ZIP publication is used as a substitute for process-tree quiescence
activation: required_next_fresh after mainline current-disk sync; current returns remain read-only
claim_boundary: Runtime lifecycle and snapshot consistency only; no DUT/RTL/config/numeric/workload, root-cause, natural-terminal, formal-D, E4 or E5 claim.
